ctx.x: So he used to come, like, once a month on business -- his name was Don Zenn, he owned an acoustical business, so he used to come to New York once a month and whenever he came up to Central Plaza, he would buy a bottle and the guys would go and sit at his table, and drink.
Well, like I say, I never was a big drinker anyway, so I would take like one drink with the rest of the guys and they'd be sitting there drinking him under the table.
